title: ShapePayloadV0
description: Typed payload for entity.type == 'shape_v0', grounded in raw wikitext sampled from the diep.io Pentagon/Alpha Pentagon/Square/Triangle pages. Structurally much simpler than tank_v0: shapes use a {{Polygon}} template with mostly-numeric fields, no upgrade chain, and no BaseStats. Shape and Tank intentionally share only the common entity envelope (entity.schema.json), not this payload. Variant relations (e.g. Pentagon -> Alpha Pentagon) are external relation_type=variant_of edges (see relation.schema.json), not embedded here.

rarity.description: Raw text of the wikitext infobox 'rarity' field, e.g. 'Very Common', 'Uncommon', 'Rare in [[Pentagon Nest]], Cannot be found outside the [[Pentagon Nest]].'. Kept as free text -- rarity descriptions were observed to include qualifiers and links, not just a clean enum value.

hp.description: The wikitext infobox 'hp' field. Observed as a genuine number on every sampled shape (Square 10, Triangle 30, Pentagon 100, Alpha Pentagon 3000).

xp.description: The wikitext infobox 'xp' field. Observed as a genuine number on every sampled shape (Square 10, Triangle 25, Pentagon 130, Alpha Pentagon 3000).

attacks.description: Raw text of the wikitext infobox 'attacks' field, when present and non-empty. Most sampled shapes left this field blank.

raw_infobox_evidence.description: Sparse bag of additional raw infobox field name/value pairs not otherwise modeled by this schema, preserved verbatim.
